title: Refund Policy
html:
Satisfaction Guarantee

Every pouch, scoop, or capsule should fuel you with clean, mushroom-powered energy. If it doesn’t, email us at support@mushroomkick.com within 30 days of delivery and request a refund.

Note: Because our products are consumable, we do not accept returns. Please keep the item or dispose of it responsibly—either way, your money comes straight back to you.

How Refunds Work

  1. Email us with your order number and a quick note about the issue.

  2. We’ll process a full refund to your original payment method the same business day we approve your request.

  3. Your bank or card issuer may take 3–5 business days to post the credit.

Exchanges

We don’t offer exchanges, but if you’re not happy with your blend or strength, shoot us an email at support@mushroomkick.com and we’ll issue a full refund—no questions asked.

Damages & Wrong Items

If your shipment arrives damaged or incorrect, send us a quick photo (optional but helpful) at support@mushroomkick.com. We’ll issue an immediate refund, and, if you’d like, send a replacement at no cost.

Need help?

We’re here for you. Reach us anytime at support@mushroomkick.com or through the Contact Us page. Thanks for choosing Mushroom Kick—cheers to cleaner, crash-free energy!
